name: Glow Starter Package
description: Perfect for your first step into medical aesthetics. Combines deep cleansing and hydration with targeted treatment for sun damage, redness, and uneven tone. A great way to see what Luminara is all about.

name: Youth Revival Package
description: Our most popular combination. Botox relaxes expression lines while filler restores volume — together they create a fully refreshed, natural look. Ideal for clients in their 30s-40s noticing both dynamic lines and volume loss.
ideal_for: Expression lines and volume loss together

name: Total Transformation Package
description: Our most comprehensive anti-aging package. Morpheus8 tightens and resurfaces from the inside, while Botox and filler address surface expression and volume. This combination delivers surgical-level results without surgery.

name: Radiance Maintenance Package
description: A 3-month skin health program alternating HydraFacials with chemical peels. Designed to restore glow, treat hyperpigmentation, and establish a healthy skin baseline. Ideal as ongoing maintenance or prep for a special event.
